about_the_game:
Blade Ball Arena is an adrenaline-fueled, high-speed dodge brawler where precision and reflexes determine victory! Step into the arena and master the art of blade ball—a thrilling fusion of dodging, deflecting, and striking. Face off against opponents in intense, fast-paced PVP battles, where every move counts and split-second decisions can mean the difference between triumph and defeat. Outsmart your rivals, unleash powerful abilities, and rise through the ranks to prove yourself as the ultimate blade ball champion!

KEY FEATURES: 

  • 4 Dynamic Arenas - Unique battlegrounds to conquer

  • 38 Weapons - A deadly arsenal at your disposal

  • 11 Skins - Customize your warrior and stand out in the arena

  • 14 Abilities - Unleash game changing powers

Choose Your Style

Discover your unique playstyle: Will you engage in psychological warfare, outsmarting your opponents with clever feints and unpredictable moves? Or will you rely on lightning-fast reflexes, aiming to outpace and overwhelm them with sheer speed? The choice is yours — master your approach, and climb to the top!

Earn Abilities

Earn new abilities through participating in matches to create your perfect load out that fits your play style, whether it's aggressive or defensive.

Personalize Your Avatar

Choose from a range of creative weapons and avatar skins, in the arena, you’re the ideal you.

Join Blade Ball Arena Now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU Threads Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, AMD Radeon RX 470, or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: No support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Blade Ball Arena is a fast-paced, easy-to-pick-up PVP game for you and your friends. No tricky rules. No tutorial. Just you, a blade, and a heat-seeking dodgeball. Got what it takes to come out on top in the Blade Ball Arena? Jump in for a game or two!

English*, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Portuguese - Brazil
